title: tree-keeper's out
description: What the tree-keeper gives as it ends: its result and its last message.

result.description: The fixed word it gives by running python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lane/result.py tree-keeper <result>. done: tree.py wrote the change, or gave 1 for other than a more refused, such as a change out of the design tree's form, and the tree is as it was. refused: tree.py refused a more, as the decision that it names isn't under its deliverable, or didn't change since the round's cut. The routes go on by this word.

reply.description: For done, what changed, each node it checked against the change, and each deliverable marked doing, as tree.py write gave them, or that nothing changed, with what tree.py write said. For refused, the more's best practice and necessary condition, and why tree.py refused it.
